newsitem.title: USA: County Seat Stores says files reorganization plan.
newsitem.headline: County Seat Stores says files reorganization plan.

text.p: County Seat Stores Inc said on Friday it has recently filed a plan of reorganization and disclosure statement in its Chapter 11 bankruptcy case which presently pends in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.
The company said in a press release that the distribution concepts embodied in the plan are supported by its creditors' committee.
Under the plan, holders of general unsecured claims against County Seat would receive 100 percent of the new common stock of reorganized County Seat Stores.

In addition, certain holders of preferred stock at the County Seat Stores level would get warrants to purchase up to 15 percent of reorganized County Seat Stores at strike prices to be determined, based upon the total value of distributions to be received by holders of general unsecured claims.

The plan also contemplates that reorganized County Seat Stores would enter into a new credit facility and issue new senior notes which would be used by reorganized County Seat Stores to make payments required by the plan and for general working capital purposes in post-confirmation operations.
The Bankruptcy Court has scheduled August 22 as the date for the hearing to consider the adequacy of the disclosure statement.
If the disclosure statement were approved, the company anticipates that a hearing on confirmation of the plan would be held on October 1.
County Seat Stores is one of the nation's largest casual wear retailers with over 450 stores in 43 states.
